English

[edit]
English Wikipedia has an article on:
kidnapping
Wikipedia

Alternative forms

[edit]
  • kidnaping (US, less common)

Pronunciation

[edit]
  • IPA(key): /ˈkɪdnæpɪŋ/
  • Audio (US):(file)

Verb

[edit]

kidnapping

  1. present participle and gerund of kidnap

Noun

[edit]

kidnapping (countable and uncountable, plural kidnappings)

  1. (crime) The crime of taking a person against their will, sometimes for ransom.

Derived terms

[edit]
  • antikidnapping
  • bridenapping
  • carnapping
  • catnapping
  • dognapping
  • express kidnapping
  • gnome-napping
  • slavenapping
  • tiger kidnapping

Translations

[edit]
the crime of taking a person against their will, sometimes for ransom
  • Albanian: rrëmbim (sq) m
  • Arabic: اِخْتِطَاف m (iḵtiṭāf)
  • Armenian: առեւանգում (hy) (aṙewangum)

  • Bulgarian: отвли́чане n (otvlíčane), похище́ние (bg) n (pohišténie)
  • Catalan: segrest (ca) m
  • Chinese:
    Mandarin: 綁架 / 绑架 (zh) (bǎngjià), 誘拐 / 诱拐 (zh) (yòuguǎi), 拐騙 / 拐骗 (zh) (guǎipiàn), 綁票 / 绑票 (zh) (bǎngpiào)
  • Czech: únos (cs) m

  • Georgian: მოტაცება (moṭaceba)
  • German: Entführung (de) f, Menschenraub m, Kinderraub m, Kidnapping (de) n
  • Greek: απαγωγή (el) f (apagogí)
